lines: Culture Minister's denial of mass rape in 1998 riots sparks outrage. The Culture Minister's denial of mass rape during the May 1998 riots has triggered a wave of condemnation with critics warning about a growing effort to erase long ignored suffering of Chinese Indonesian women and sanitize one of the country's darkest chapters.
